observations: body L1, L3, L5, L16, L18, L20, L22, L33: the minus signs are printed as long dashes (9.6 to 10.6 pt; that of «180° − 2ε» in L16 8.2 pt); they are set as minus signs.

body L1-L5: rule (α) is checked. With sin (P − 90°) = − cos P it is the form of L5. For the radius 1, with sin α = tg δ cotg ε (chapter 5, L21) and − cos P = tg φ tg ε (the longest day, p. 180), it gives sin m = tg φ tg δ, the ascensional difference.
body L5: the fraction bar under «sin α cos P» did not print; it is set.
body L6, L24: the dashes of «97–98» and «92–94» measure 5.5 and about 5.3 pt (the second joined to the 2), long dashes.

body L7-L14: the first figure stands at the left of lines 7 to 14, which are set beside it in a narrow measure. It is redrawn from measurements of the print: the meridian ABGD as a circle; the horizon BED and the equator AEG as flat arcs of circles, as printed; the arcs ZHT and LKZ of the circles of declination, which meet at the south pole Z; the axis through E in dashes, each dash where it printed; the upright bold letters, and the italic words horizon and aequator.

body L7-L22: the formulas are checked. In the first figure TH = ε, ZH = 90° − ε, TE = P − 90° (TEG = P, EG = 90°), EL the ascensional difference, KL = δ and KZ = 90° − δ; Menelaus' theorem gives L14 and L16 (chorda 2a = 2 sin a, chorda (180° − 2a) = 2 cos a), whence L18 and L20; with al-Battānī's sin α = R sin δ cos ε / (cos δ sin ε) it gives L22, the same as (α).
body L13: a spot of ink stands in the bowl of the D of «BED»; it is not a sign.
body L21, L36: the dash of «Al–Battānī» in L21 measures 5.4 pt, a long dash; the letter-spaced «al-Battānī» of L36 has a hyphen (3.6 pt). Kept as printed.

body L23-L31: the second figure stands at the right of lines 23 to 31, which are set beside it in a narrow measure. It is redrawn from measurements of the print: the meridian ABGD as a circle; the horizon BED, the equator AEG, the ecliptic Z♈T and the circle of declination KM as arcs of circles, as printed (the horizon, the ecliptic and KM meet in L); the axis through E in dashes, each dash where it printed; the bold italic letters and the sign of Aries.

body L23-L35: the formulas are checked. In the second figure KD = φ, DG = 90° − φ, KL = 90° − δ, LM = δ, ME = m and EG = 90°; Menelaus' theorem gives L31 and L33, and with sines L35, that is sin m = R tg φ tg δ.
body L33: a speck stands after the sign =; it is not a sign.
